name: Become Elite
source: Your rich uncle has suddenly passed away! You're going to inherit a share of his will, including the famous Water Lily estate. Together with three obnoxious butlers, you will spend the next three weeks training to come out into society at a formal debut.
translation: 富有的叔叔突然去世！你将继承遗嘱的一部分，包括著名的睡莲庄园。接下来三周，你要与三名讨厌的管家一起训练，为正式社交出道做准备。
